::: {.hero}
# What is <span style="color:#ede3cc;">BaltimoreComedy.org</span>?

<div class="gold-rule"></div>

:::

Baltimore Comedy.org is a free, centralized platform connecting Baltimore-area comedy audiences with comedians, shows, and open mics. It operates on a principle of open access and minimal gatekeeping: any comedian or show can be listed, submissions are reviewed for basic completeness rather than curated by taste, and the platform does not manage or represent talent.

The underlying premise: Baltimore's local comedians are as talented as anyone appearing on a Netflix special or HBO special. What they lack isn't skill, it's the marketing budget and institutional backing that comes with a corporate deal. Baltimore Comedy.org's model is built around that gap: since the platform can't out-spend a studio's marketing budget, it competes by out-organizing — pooling audience attention and community support in one place instead of leaving each comedian to build an audience alone.

B'more is stronger together.
